title: Hot Work Permit (Enhanced)
description: Free Hot Work Permit (Enhanced) template for construction you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers permit information, hazard identification, attached documents.

Precaution Measures Checklist

Precaution measures require to complete the work safelyYesNoN/ARemarks
Are you certified (welder) to undertake this work? Is Equipment/Machine inspected and color coding available of the current month? Are all combustible materials removed or shielded from sparks? Are the hoses inspected? Free from grease/oil, cuts/cracks? Are fittings with special clamps in place? Are regulators and Gauges inspected? No defects/broken fittings? Are gauges calibrated? Are flash back arrestors provided? Are cylinders provided with cap, trolley, chain and appropriate relieve valve? Are cylinders stored in upright position and secured? Are cylinders stored away from heat sources and combustible materials? Is the work area adequately ventilated? Is a fire watch assigned and in position? Are emergency team available or contact numbers displayed? Have tools and devices to be used been tested and adjusted? Are welding screens/curtains in place to protect others? Is the work area free of flammable liquids/gases? Are floor and wall openings covered to prevent spark entry? Are fire-resistant blankets/curtains used to protect equipment?☐

Fire Watch Requirements

FIRE WATCH PERSONNEL:

NAMESTART TIMEEND TIMESIGNATURE
________ ___________________ ______________________ ___________________ ________

FIRE WATCH RESPONSIBILITIES:

☐ Continuously monitor for fires and sparks during hot work operations

☐ Maintain fire extinguishing equipment immediately available

☐ Watch for fires in all exposed areas, including floors above and below

☐ Attempt to extinguish any fires that start within capability

☐ Sound alarm and evacuate if fire cannot be controlled

☐ Monitor area for at least 30 minutes after hot work ceases

☐ Conduct final inspection of work area before leaving
